The '''Lytton sector''' was in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]], which included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]].

==History==
The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was represented by [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].
